text: I have an internship interview for a position at Duolingo next week! I’m feeling nervous and excited at the same time. Congratulations! That’s a great opportunity. What are you most worried about during the interview? I’m not sure how to answer questions about my experience when I haven’t had a formal internship before. Don’t worry. You have transferable skills from your coursework and extracurricular activities. Highlight your teamwork, communication, and problem-solving abilities. That’s a good tip! Maybe I can even prepare some specific examples from my projects or volunteer work that demonstrate those skills. Absolutely! Research the company and the position thoroughly. Prepare questions for the interviewer to show your genuine interest and initiative. Thanks! What kind of questions are good to ask? Ask about typical tasks and responsibilities, the company culture, and opportunities for learning and growth. Avoid generic questions you can find online. Perfect! I’ll start preparing based on your advice. Maybe we can even do a mock interview so I can practice answering questions confidently? I’d be happy to help! Remember, confidence and enthusiasm go a long way in interviews. You’ve got this!
